text_en: Then bring near to you your brother Aaron, and his sons with him, from among the Israelites, to serve me as priests—Aaron and Aaron’s sons, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
text_cn: 你应从以色列子民中叫你的哥哥亚郎同他的儿子们，即亚郎和他的儿子，纳达布、阿彼胡、厄肋阿匝尔和依塔玛尔，一起来到你前，立他们作我的司祭。

text_en: You shall make sacred vestments for the glorious adornment of your brother Aaron.
text_cn: 应给你的哥哥亚郎做圣衣，以示庄严美观。

text_en: And you shall speak to all who have ability, whom I have endowed with skill, that they make Aaron’s vestments to consecrate him for my priesthood.
text_cn: 凡我使之具备艺术天才的艺术人员，你应吩咐他们为亚郎做服装，祝圣他作我的司祭。

text_en: These are the vestments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a checkered tunic, a turban, and a sash. When they make these sacred vestments for your brother Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests,
text_cn: 他们应做的服装如下：胸牌、厄弗得、无袖长袍、织成的长衣、礼冠和腰带。他们为你的哥哥亚郎和他的儿子们做这些圣衣，叫他们作我的司祭。

text_en: they shall use gold, blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and fine linen.
text_cn: 他们应用金线，紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和细麻去做。

text_en: They shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen, skillfully worked.
text_cn: 他们应用绣工以金线，紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线，和捻的细麻做厄弗得。

text_en: It shall have two shoulder-pieces attached to its two edges, so that it may be joined together.
text_cn: 两条肩带应结连在厄弗得的两端。

text_en: The decorated band on it shall be of the same workmanship and materials, of gold, of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen.
text_cn: 将厄弗得束在身上用的带子，也应像厄弗得一样做法，与厄弗得连在一起，全是用金线、紫色、朱红色的毛线和捻的细麻做成的。

text_en: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel,
text_cn: 再取两块红玛瑙石，将以色列的儿子的名字刻在上面，

text_en: six of their names on the one stone, and the names of the remaining six on the other stone, in the order of their birth.
text_cn: 六个名字刻在一块宝石上，另六个名字刻在另一块宝石上，全照他们出生的次序。

text_en: As a gem-cutter engraves signets, so you shall engrave the two stones with the names of the sons of Israel; you shall mount them in settings of gold filigree.
text_cn: 以玉工雕刻法，好似刻印章，把以色列的儿子们的名字刻在这两块宝石上，嵌在金框内。

text_en: You shall set the two stones on the shoulder-pieces of the ephod, as stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel; and Aaron shall bear their names before the Lord on his two shoulders for remembrance.
text_cn: 再将这两块宝石，即以色列子民的纪念石，挂在厄弗得的肩带上；亚郎要在上主前常在两肩上带着他们的名字，好获得纪念。

text_en: You shall make settings of gold filigree,
text_cn: 要做两个金框，

text_en: and two chains of pure gold, twisted like cords; and you shall attach the corded chains to the settings.
text_cn: 两条纯金的链子，要像做绳子一样拧成，把这像绳子的金链结在框子上。

text_en: You shall make a breastpiece of judgment, in skilled work; you shall make it in the style of the ephod; of gold, of blue and purple and crimson yarns, and of fine twisted linen you shall make it.
text_cn: 应以绣工做判断的胸牌，像做厄弗得，用金线，紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线和捻的细麻去做。

text_en: It shall be square and doubled, a span in length and a span in width.
text_cn: 胸牌要方形，双层，一拃长，一拃宽。

text_en: You shall set in it four rows of stones. A row of carnelian, chrysolite, and emerald shall be the first row;
text_cn: 将镶嵌的宝石安装在上面，排成四行：第一行：赤玉、青玉、翡翠；

text_en: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a moonstone;
text_cn: 第二行：紫宝石、蓝玉、金钢石；

text_en: and the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
text_cn: 第三行：黄玛瑙、白玛瑙、紫晶；

text_en: and the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper; they shall be set in gold filigree.
text_cn: 第四行：黄玉、红玛瑙、水苍玉；这些宝石都嵌在金框内。

text_en: There shall be twelve stones with names corresponding to the names of the sons of Israel; they shall be like signets, each engraved with its name, for the twelve tribes.
text_cn: 按照以色列的儿子的名字，宝石应有十二块，按刻印法，每块刻一个名字，代表十二支派。

text_en: You shall make for the breastpiece chains of pure gold, twisted like cords;
text_cn: 为胸牌再做两条纯金链子，像绳子一样拧成。

text_en: and you shall make for the breastpiece two rings of gold, and put the two rings on the two edges of the breastpiece.
text_cn: 在胸牌上做两个金环，将两个金环安在胸牌的两端，

text_en: You shall put the two cords of gold in the two rings at the edges of the breastpiece;
text_cn: 将那两条金链结在胸牌两端的环子上，

text_en: the two ends of the two cords you shall attach to the two settings, and so attach it in front to the shoulder-pieces of the ephod.
text_cn: 把两条链子的另两端，结在那挂在厄弗得的肩带前面的两个框子上。

text_en: You shall make two rings of gold, and put them at the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inside edge next to the ephod.
text_cn: 再做两个金环，安在胸牌的下两端，靠近厄弗得的内边缘上。

text_en: You shall make two rings of gold, and attach them in front to the lower part of the two shoulder-pieces of the ephod, at its joining above the decorated band of the ephod.
text_cn: 再做两个金环，安在厄弗得前面两肩带的下边，靠近厄弗得带子的上边与肩带相连结的地方。

text_en: The breastpiece shall be bound by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord, so that it may lie on the decorated band of the ephod, and so that the breastpiece shall not come loose from the ephod.
text_cn: 用一根紫绳把胸牌的环子系在厄弗得的环子上，使胸牌结在厄弗得的带子上，免得胸牌在厄弗得上移动。

text_en: So Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel in the breastpiece of judgment on his heart when he goes into the holy place, for a continual remembrance before the Lord .
text_cn: 如此亚郎进圣所时，在他的胸前，在判断的胸牌上带着以色列儿子们的名字，为在上主前常获得纪念。

text_en: In the breastpiece of judgment you shall put the Urim and the Thummim, and they shall be on Aaron’s heart when he goes in before the Lord ; thus Aaron shall bear the judgment of the Israelites on his heart before the Lord continually.
text_cn: 在决断的胸牌内应放上乌陵和突明，几时亚郎进到上主前常带在亚郎胸前：如此亚郎在上主前时，胸前常带着为以色列子民行决断的工具。

text_en: You shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
text_cn: 再为厄弗得做一无袖长袍，应全是紫色毛线的。

text_en: It shall have an opening for the head in the middle of it, with a woven binding around the opening, like the opening in a coat of mail, so that it may not be torn.
text_cn: 中间留一领口，领口周围叫织工做上边，像战袍的领口，免得破裂。

text_en: On its lower hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, purple, and crimson yarns, all around the lower hem, with bells of gold between them all around—
text_cn: 在长袍底边周围做上紫色、红色、朱红色的毛线石榴；在石榴中间，周围再做上金铃铛：

text_en: a golden bell and a pomegranate alternating all around the lower hem of the robe.
text_cn: 如此在长袍底边周围，一个金铃铛，一个石榴；一个金铃铛，一个石榴。

text_en: Aaron shall wear it when he ministers, and its sound shall be heard when he goes into the holy place before the Lord , and when he comes out, so that he may not die.
text_cn: 当亚郎穿着行礼时，能听见他进圣所到上主前，或者出来的声音，免得他死亡。

text_en: You shall make a rosette of pure gold, and engrave on it, like the engraving of a signet, “Holy to the Lord . ”
text_cn: 应用纯金制一个牌子，在上面像刻印章刻上‘祝圣于上主’。

text_en: You shall fasten it on the turban with a blue cord; it shall be on the front of the turban.
text_cn: 用紫绳子将牌子系在礼冠上，即系在礼冠的前面。

text_en: It shall be on Aaron’s forehead, and Aaron shall take on himself any guilt incurred in the holy offering that the Israelites consecrate as their sacred donations; it shall always be on his forehead, in order that they may find favor before the Lord .
text_cn: 那牌常在亚郎的额上，好叫亚郎担当以色列子民祝圣各种圣物时，干犯圣物的罪过；那牌常在亚郎的额上，为使人民在上主前获得悦纳。

text_en: You shall make the checkered tunic of fine linen, and you shall make a turban of fine linen, and you shall make a sash embroidered with needlework.
text_cn: 应用细麻编制长衣，并用细麻做礼冠；腰带应是编成的。

text_en: For Aaron’s sons you shall make tunics and sashes and headdresses; you shall make them for their glorious adornment.
text_cn: 也要为亚郎的儿子们做长衣、腰带和头巾，以示庄严美观。

text_en: You shall put them on your brother Aaron, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them and ordain them and consecrate them, so that they may serve me as priests.
text_cn: 你把这些服装给你哥哥亚郎和他的儿子穿上；给他们傅油，授与圣职，祝圣他们作我的司祭。

text_en: You shall make for them linen undergarments to cover their naked flesh; they shall reach from the hips to the thighs;
text_cn: 还应给他们用麻布做裤子，从腰部直到大腿，遮盖他们的裸体。

text_en: Aaron and his sons shall wear them when they go into the tent of meeting, or when they come near the altar to minister in the holy place; or they will bring guilt on themselves and die. This shall be a perpetual ordinance for him and for his descendants after him.
text_cn: 当亚郎和他的儿子们进入会幕或走近祭台，在圣所内行礼时，要穿上裤子，免得招致惩罚死亡：这为亚郎和他的后代是永远的规律。
